description: This file contains a unit test (using pytest) for verifying that the maximum token count gets appropriately adjusted when exceeding the limit in the litellm library. It sets some configurations, calls the completion function with specific parameters, and includes a skipped test case for AWS SageMaker deployment.

methods.name: test_completion_sagemaker()
